fit_reason: Designs and sells liquid- and air-cooled AI servers, blade systems and rackmount systems, and offers rack-level design-to-deployment for full-rack AI and HPC clusters. Servers and racks are essentially the whole business, making it the purest server and rack-scale maker in the list.

Sells rack, blade and hyperscale servers through its Infrastructure Solutions Group, alongside storage and networking, and is one of the largest AI server vendors. Servers are central to the infrastructure segment, though PCs and VMware also make up a large share of the company.

Sells ProLiant rack servers, BladeSystem, Synergy and Cray/Apollo HPC systems, so servers and HPC systems are a core part of the business. A leading incumbent server and supercomputer maker extending into AI rack-scale systems, with networking (Aruba) as a second leg.

Contract manufacturer whose Connectivity & Cloud Solutions segment builds servers, switches, storage and data center interconnect hardware for hyperscalers, including mechanical and systems integration. Hyperscaler server and rack assembly is central to its growth, and it is a major player in this role.

Its Enclosures segment (Hoffman, Schroff) makes metal and non-metal enclosures, cabinets, sub-racks and backplanes, including physical infrastructure for hosting server and network equipment, sold through data center installers. Racks and enclosures are its largest segment and a leading brand in the category.

Third-largest server vendor through its Infrastructure Solutions Group, with motherboard design, system integration and full-rack assembly for servers and storage. Servers are a meaningful part of a business dominated by PCs and devices.

EMS provider that engineers custom plastic and metal enclosures and does systems assembly, configure-to-order and integration for cloud infrastructure and networking customers. A large contract manufacturer where cloud and data center is a meaningful but not sole part of the business.

EMS provider doing systems assembly and enclosure fabrication for cloud computing and communications customers, plus power supplies, power distribution units and busway for servers and data centers. Data center is a meaningful part of a broad manufacturing business that also includes Nextracker.

Contract manufacturer that builds complete systems and subassemblies, plus custom enclosures, backplanes, cable assemblies and PCBs, for cloud computing and other customers. Server and rack-related build work is a meaningful part of a diversified EMS business.

Sells integrated rack systems along with power management and thermal control for data centers, so the rack is one piece of a broader data center infrastructure offering. Primarily a power and cooling company, with racks and prefabricated modules as an adjacent part.

Penguin Computing builds HPC and AI servers for core data centers and cloud, and the company also owns the Stratus fault-tolerant server line. Advanced Computing is one of three segments, alongside memory modules and LEDs.

Distributor that also provides integration and production services such as burn-in, thermal and power-draw testing for servers, and supplies hyperscale and hyper-converged infrastructure. Server integration and distribution is a meaningful part of the business, but it is not a maker of the systems.

Infrastructure segment sells on-premises and cloud server and storage systems (Power, Z) for regulated and mission-critical workloads. Servers are a small part of a business that is mostly software and consulting.

Delivers its AI compute platform built around the wafer-scale engine as rack-mountable systems for data centers and supercomputer-scale clusters. It sells complete systems rather than just chips, but it is mainly a new accelerator design and a small player in rack-level deployment.

Energy Systems segment makes thermally managed cabinets and enclosures for electronic equipment and integrated power solutions for data centers, alongside UPS. Enclosures are a minor part of a business focused on industrial batteries.

Enterprise Solutions sells copper and fiber cabling, interconnect panels, racks and enclosures, plus power, cooling and airflow management products for data centers. Racks and enclosures are one product line within a broader signal-transmission business.

EMS provider that does PCB assembly, electromechanical assembly and full system integration for advanced computing and telecom customers. The description does not show server or rack work specifically, so it is a thin fit.
